"""One frozen shared-layout cohort; no flags or allocator search."""
import sys,json,re
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'tools')
from fzgx import api,fixup,oracle
from fzgx.project import Project
p=Project('GFZE01');out=Path('.fzgx/manual-device-review/bgwin-string-layout');e=fixup.Engine(p,out);rows=[]
keys=['main_rel:fn_1_15B970','main_rel:fn_1_15BA78']
for key in keys:
 s=p.resolve(key);u=p.unit_record(p.unit_of(s));mw,flags=oracle.version_for(p,s);body=api._canonical_text(p,u['source']);rows.append(e.record(key,body,mw,flags,label='installed source control'))
def add(base,text,label):
 assert text!=Path(base['source']).read_text()
 row=e.record(base['symbol'],text,base['mw'],base['flags'],parent=base['id'],label=label);rows.append(row);return row
with oracle.build_lock():
 e.evaluate(rows);assert all(r.get('matched') for r in rows)
 init,lookup=rows[:2];a=Path(init['source']).read_text()
 a,n=re.subn(r'typedef struct \{\s*u8 pad_0\[0x8\];.*?\} WinObject;\n','',a,flags=re.S);assert n==1
 a=a.replace('WinObject *obj','BgWinStringTable *obj')
 for old,new in [('obj->unk_8','obj->count'),('obj->unk_C','obj->entries_offset'),('obj->unk_10','obj->results_offset')]:a=a.replace(old,new)
 add(init,a,'share endian-conversion header layout')
 typed=a.replace('u32 *a = (u32 *)','BgWinStringEntry *a = (BgWinStringEntry *)').replace('u32 *b = (u32 *)','BgWinStringResult *b = (BgWinStringResult *)')
 for old,new in [('a[1]','a->name_offset'),('a[0]','a->length'),('b[1]','b->value_offset'),('b[0]','b->unk_0')]:typed=typed.replace(old,new)
 add(init,typed,'share header and both endian-converted row layouts')
 indexed=typed.replace('    u32 offset;\n','').replace('        offset = 0;\n','').replace('            offset += 8;\n','')
 indexed=indexed.replace('(BgWinStringEntry *)((u8 *)obj + obj->entries_offset + offset)','(BgWinStringEntry *)((u8 *)obj + obj->entries_offset) + count').replace('(BgWinStringResult *)((u8 *)obj + obj->results_offset + offset)','(BgWinStringResult *)((u8 *)obj + obj->results_offset) + count')
 add(init,indexed,'ordinary typed indexed endian-conversion loop')
 b=Path(lookup['source']).read_text();b,n=re.subn(r'typedef struct \{\s*u8 pad_00\[0x08\];.*?\} StringTable;\n','',b,flags=re.S);assert n==1
 b=re.sub(r'\bStringTable\b','BgWinStringTable',b)
 add(lookup,b,'share lookup header layout; retain measured staging')
 typed=b.replace('u8 *entry = (u8 *)table + table->entries_offset + index * 8;','BgWinStringEntry *entry = (BgWinStringEntry *)((u8 *)table + table->entries_offset) + index;').replace('*(u32 *)entry','entry->length').replace('*(u32 *)(entry + 4)','entry->name_offset').replace('*(u32 *)((u8 *)table + table->results_offset + index * 8 + 4)','((BgWinStringResult *)((u8 *)table + table->results_offset))[index].value_offset')
 add(lookup,typed,'typed indexed lookup entries and results; retain measured staging')
 old='{ BgWinStringTable * __reg_value_table = (*(BgWinStringTable * *)&lbl_1_bss_8F8D0); table = __reg_value_table; }';assert old in b
 for text,label in [(b,'shared header'),(typed,'typed entries and results')]:
  add(lookup,text.replace(old,'table = (BgWinStringTable *)lbl_1_bss_8F8D0.unk_0;'),'direct global field; '+label)
 e.evaluate(rows[2:])
report=dict(hypothesis='Recover common string-resource header and 8-byte rows from endian conversion and lookup accesses, preserving byte/field order and unknown words.',stopping_condition='Two exact controls and seven fixed source hypotheses once, with unchanged actual compiler profiles.',records=rows,best={},frontier={'all_frozen_probes':rows},generator_sha256=e.generator_sha256,environment=e.environment)
(out/'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n');fixup.archive_sources(report,out/'sources.json.gz')
for row in rows:print(row['symbol'],row['label'],bool(row.get('matched')),row.get('word_errors'),row.get('extra_helpers'))

remeasure_script.text:
"""Re-measure the frozen bg_win string-layout cohort under the installed header.

Re-records every original probe body (same text, label, parent chain, compiler and
flags) in a fresh engine directory, adds the installed whitespace-tidied
fn_1_15BA78 as one control, recompiles the MWCC layout probe, and writes the
portable archive. No search, flags or allocator work.
"""
import sys, json, hashlib, subprocess, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, 'tools')
from fzgx import api, fixup, oracle
from fzgx.project import Project

ROOT = Path.cwd()
old_dir = Path('.fzgx/manual-device-review/bgwin-string-layout')
out = Path('.fzgx/manual-device-review/bgwin-string-layout-final')
old = json.loads((old_dir / 'report.json').read_text())
p = Project('GFZE01')
e = fixup.Engine(p, out)
assert e.generator_sha256 == old['generator_sha256'], 'generator drift'

ids, rows = {}, []
pending = list(old['records'])
while pending:
    r = next(r for r in pending if not r.get('parent') or r['parent'] in ids)
    pending.remove(r)
    text = Path(r['source']).read_text()
    assert hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest() == r['sha256']
    meta = {'label': r['label']}
    if r.get('parent'):
        meta['parent'] = ids[r['parent']]
    row = e.record(r['symbol'], text, r['mw'], r['flags'], **meta)
    assert row['compile_profile'] == r['compile_profile'], r['label']
    row['original_measurement'] = {k: r.get(k) for k in ('matched', 'word_errors', 'score')}
    ids[r['id']] = row['id']
    rows.append(row)

key = 'main_rel:fn_1_15BA78'
s = p.resolve(key)
installed = {}
for k in ('main_rel:fn_1_15B970', key):
    sym = p.resolve(k)
    installed[k] = api._canonical_text(p, p.unit_record(p.unit_of(sym))['source'])
parent = next(r for r in rows if r['sha256'].startswith('656691262493'))
tidy = e.record(key, installed[key], parent['mw'], parent['flags'], parent=parent['id'],
                label='installed form; drop blank line left by removed local layout')
assert tidy['compile_profile'] == parent['compile_profile']
_mw, _fl = oracle.version_for(p, s)
assert (_mw, _fl or '') == (parent['mw'], parent['flags'])
rows.append(tidy)

with oracle.build_lock():
    e.evaluate(rows)

for row in rows:
    o = row.get('original_measurement')
    if o is not None:
        assert bool(row.get('matched')) == bool(o['matched']) and row.get('word_errors') == o['word_errors'], (row['label'], row.get('word_errors'), o)
assert tidy.get('matched') and tidy.get('word_errors') == 0
for k, text in installed.items():
    sha = hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest()
    assert any(r['symbol'] == p.key(p.resolve(k)) and r['sha256'] == sha and r.get('matched') for r in rows), k

# MWCC layout proof against the installed header.
probe = Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text()
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=out) as tmp:
    src = Path(tmp) / 'bgwin_layout_probe.c'
    src.write_text(probe)
    cmd = oracle.compile_command(p, 'main_rel', 'GC/1.3.2', '') + ['-c', str(src), '-o', tmp]
    subprocess.run(cmd, check=True, cwd=ROOT)
    obj = Path(tmp) / 'bgwin_layout_probe.o'
    data = obj.read_bytes()
    obj_sha = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
    from fzgx.poolfix import Elf
    elf = Elf(data)
    sym = next(x for x in elf.symbols() if x['name'] == 'bgwin_string_layout_probe')
    sec = elf.sections[sym['shndx']]
    raw = data[sec['offset'] + sym['value']: sec['offset'] + sym['value'] + sym['size']]
    emitted = [int.from_bytes(raw[i:i + 4], 'big') for i in range(0, len(raw), 4)]
layout = dict(compiler='GC/1.3.2', flags='', source=probe, object_sha256=obj_sha,
              emitted_values=emitted,
              expected_values=[0x1C, 8, 8, 8, 0xC, 0x10, 0x14, 0x18, 0, 4, 0, 4, 0x10])
assert emitted == layout['expected_values'], emitted
(out / 'layout-proof.json').write_text(json.dumps(layout, indent=2) + '\n')

report = dict(old, records=rows, frontier={'all_frozen_probes': rows}, best={},
              environment=e.environment,
              note='Re-measurement of the frozen cohort under the installed header plus one installed-form control.')
(out / 'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
fixup.archive_sources(report, Path('state/repairs/bgwin-string-layout-20261116.sources.json.gz'))
for row in rows:
    print(row['symbol'], row['sha256'][:12], bool(row.get('matched')), row.get('word_errors'), row['label'])
print('layout', emitted)
